choices.topic: Round each test's values before summarising?
choices.opus: No: summaries taken from unrounded fitted values.
choices.sonnet: No: summaries taken from unrounded fitted values.
choices.authors: Evidently used per-test values rounded to the printed precision before summarising.
choices.matters: Both models: 2 cells (range of s at 30 min, CV of r2 at 45 min), last digit flips.

choices.topic: Which 31st test counts as M2CA alone?
choices.opus: Test 1 (A alone) of all 30 combinations plus the sham's B-alone test; rejected the sham's mixture test.
choices.sonnet: Same 31 tests; rejected using the sham's mixture test or dropping to 30.
choices.authors: Same 31 tests; the authors' supplement confirms it.

choices.topic: Fit duplicate readings separately or averaged first?
choices.opus: Both duplicates fitted as separate points, unweighted least squares (14 points per curve).
choices.sonnet: Both duplicates fitted as separate points, unweighted least squares.
choices.authors: Not known; model fits matched authors' deposited values to 4 decimals except two 45-minute curves.

choices.topic: Which exact curve equation was fitted?
choices.opus: Extractor's reading: five-parameter logistic, maximum 100, parameterised by EC50; EC25 and EC75 solved from the curve.
choices.sonnet: Same equation as given (maximum fixed at 100); EC values solved from the fitted curve.

choices.topic: Starting values and limits for the curve fits?
choices.opus: Automatic starts with a multistart grid; Hill slope limited to 0.001 to 50 for stability only.
choices.sonnet: Grid of starting values, best fit kept; own limits on EC50, s and Hill slope (0.05 to 50).

choices.opus: Slope is the Hill slope parameter; r2 = 1 - residual/total squares over all replicate points.
choices.sonnet: Slope is the Hill slope; r2 over all raw replicate points around their mean.

choices.topic: Spread measures: SD denominator and meaning of range?
choices.opus: SD with n - 1; CV = SD/mean x 100; range as one number, maximum minus minimum.
choices.sonnet: Same: SD with n - 1, range as maximum minus minimum.
